posts.description: https://www.journalismaifestival.com/ Seminar: most journalists are NOT technical, often have slow take up of new tech. So they’re cautious of AI tools. A few pioneers may embrace them, but things spread slowly within newsrooms. Should therefore involve editorial in decisions about AI tech early on. AI = NLP for analysis; synthetic text; finding patterns in data faster than people can; article rec
